heading: Rooted in Miami Gardens. Fighting for Our Future.
text: Rooted in Miami Gardens and shaped by the people who raised him, taught him, and stood by him, Oliver Gilbert is running to give back to the community that made him who he is. Raised in Miami Gardens, educated in local public schools, and shaped by a lifetime of service to his community, he is running to build a stronger future for South Florida.

heading: Rooted in Miami Gardens. Fighting for Our Future.
text: His story is one of faith, perseverance, and service — from supporting himself as a college student and riding the bus to law school, to leading his growing hometown as Mayor and bringing safer neighborhoods, more parks, real economic growth, to fighting as a County Commissioner for better public transit, housing people can afford, and economic growth that benefits the entire region — his focus has always been on creating stronger neighborhoods, more resilient communities, and a better future for working families.

heading: Rooted in Miami Gardens. Fighting for Our Future.
text: At every step, his purpose has remained the same: to bring opportunity home and build a South Florida where every family has a fair shot.

heading: Most people want the same things.
text: They want to get to work without losing half their day. They want to see a doctor without dreading the bill. They want their kids to inherit an economy that rewards effort.

heading: Their time back.
text: A two-hour commute isn’t a transit problem. It’s a family problem, a cost problem, and a life problem.

heading: Care they can afford.
text: Nobody should wait until it’s too late to see a doctor because of the bill. Coverage isn’t a luxury. It’s a foundation.

heading: A real shot.
text: Small businesses and working families built South Florida. They deserve a federal government that builds with them — not around them.

heading: Donate Today
text: This is the most meaningful endorsement I could ask for.

heading: Donate Today
text: Congresswoman Wilson has fought for this community for decades, the last 15 years in Congress doing the hard work to move our community and country forward and she does not give her word lightly.

heading: Donate Today
text: She knows better than anyone what’s needed in Washington. I grew up right here in South Florida, in Miami Gardens. I know what families here are up against, because I have lived it. Rent that eats half a paycheck. Healthcare people cannot afford. A commute that swallows the day. I am running to change that. Not with promises, but with work.

heading: Donate Today
text: I am humbled to have her trust, and I will work every day to be worthy of it.

heading: On the Issues
text: Gas is $5 a gallon, rent is half your paycheck, and every trip to the grocery store gets more expensive. For far too many neighbors, this has been the reality for far too long.

heading: On the Issues
text: Oliver Gilbert lived these challenges growing up in Miami Gardens, working his way through college and law school, and leading our city as Mayor and County Commissioner.

heading: On the Issues
text: What do President Trump and Washington Republicans do to help during these tough times? They spend your money on a war you didn’t ask for, didn’t vote for, and don’t need. They build a billion dollar ballroom for the Mar-a-Lago crowd. And they even use your own money to lie right to your face, spending millions on TV ads to deny the truth and divide our communities.

heading: On the Issues
text: South Florida families have had enough. It’s time to Put People First.

heading: Healthcare For All
text: We’re the richest country on earth, but we send billions of dollars to other countries so they can afford universal healthcare. How does that make sense? In Congress, Oliver will fight for a pathway to ensure that healthcare is a right for every American.

heading: Eliminate Income Taxes for Working Families
text: Families who are working hard to make ends meet shouldn’t have to carry the same tax burden as billionaires. The IRS should be spending more time auditing the ultra-wealthy than scrutinizing an Uber driver’s gas deduction. Oliver supports common sense tax policies indexed to what families in our communities actually earn, so that relief reaches the people who need it most and keeps money in working people’s hands.

heading: Stop ICE Raids Now
text: Our government has shamefully spent billions ripping families apart. They said ICE would only target criminals, but every day more and more hardworking people are being arrested and deported, often leaving young children behind to fend for themselves or leaving the only country they’ve ever known. It’s time to end funding for these shameful deportation policies and redirect that investment where it belongs: into our communities.

heading: Universal Childcare & Pre-K
text: Countries around the world have made universal childcare a reality. As a father, Oliver knows the challenges families are facing every day. In Washington, he will redirect spending toward our children and families, so that the resources no longer being wasted on mass deportations start building something that actually lasts.

heading: Expand Rapid Transit
text: In Congress, Oliver will fight to secure the federal funding needed to ensure the job gets done, and that our residents get the transit solutions they’ve been promised for decades.

heading: Investing in Jobs & Job Training
text: Oliver will fight in Washington to reinvest in job training, especially in high-paying technical fields that can’t easily be taken away by AI, and to strengthen support for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

heading: The BUILD Business Act
text: America should not only be the best place in the world to work. It should be the best place in the world to start a business.

heading: The BUILD Act
text: Every student deserves a pathway to purpose. The BUILD Act prepares students for the economy of tomorrow by connecting education to real careers, expanding apprenticeships, supporting teachers, rewarding innovation, and building the workforce America needs to compete.

heading: The CARE Act
text: Every person with a lifelong disability deserves healthcare, a safe home, meaningful relationships, and the support to live with dignity throughout every stage of life.

heading: The HOME Act
text: The HOME Act lowers monthly housing costs without weakening lending standards — helping responsible families own a home, build generational wealth, and gain long-term financial stability.

heading: BUILD Business Act
text: Small businesses are the backbone of the American economy. The BUILD Business Act modernizes the Small Business Administration by expanding access to capital, reducing barriers to entrepreneurship, and helping more Americans start, grow, and expand successful businesses.

heading: 01 / The Challenge
text: Too many entrepreneurs have the talent and determination to succeed but cannot access the capital needed to get started. The BUILD Business Act closes that gap by pairing affordable financing with mentorship, accountability, and streamlined government.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Eleven concrete actions to help Americans start, grow, and expand small businesses. Tap any item to expand.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Create the American Small Business Grant Program providing grants of $5,000 to $25,000 for equipment, inventory, software, licensing, insurance, lease deposits, and other startup costs.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Give entrepreneurs access to capital before debt becomes necessary.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Establish the SBA Growth Line offering low interest loans, generally from 0% to 2%, with deferred repayment.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Help growing businesses scale without being overwhelmed by early debt.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Strengthen the SBA 7(a) program by increasing federal guarantees, reducing borrower fees, simplifying approvals, speeding processing, and expanding lending in underserved communities.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Strengthen the SBA 504 program by expanding funding, modernizing eligibility, speeding project approvals, and creating a new 504 Express Expansion track for established businesses creating jobs.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Provide enhanced financing incentives for businesses that establish employee ownership and profit-sharing programs.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Help workers build wealth alongside the businesses they help build.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Combine startup grants, affordable financing, technical assistance, and contracting opportunities in targeted commercial corridors.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Revitalize communities through local entrepreneurship.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Reduce lender risk by covering the initial portion of losses on qualifying startup loans.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Encourage more private lending to promising entrepreneurs.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Create one digital portal for grants, loans, mentoring, technical assistance, and contracting opportunities.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Make government easier to navigate.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Partner with universities, chambers of commerce, Small Business Development Centers, experienced business mentors, minority business organizations, and local economic development agencies.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Publish annual reports measuring business creation, job creation, survival rates, loan performance, and taxpayer return on investment.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Simplify procurement and help more small businesses compete for government contracts.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Create reliable customers, not just affordable financing.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Reduce paperwork, simplify reporting requirements, coordinate permitting where possible, and expand digital services.

heading: 02 / My Plan
text: Goal: Let entrepreneurs spend more time growing businesses.

heading: Real Help, Right Where You Are
text: Opening your first restaurant? Access startup grants and affordable financing.

heading: Real Help, Right Where You Are
text: Buying your first commercial building? A strengthened SBA 504 program makes expansion easier.

heading: Real Help, Right Where You Are
text: Growing a construction, trucking, retail, or service business? A stronger SBA 7(a) program helps finance hiring and equipment.

heading: Real Help, Right Where You Are
text: Veteran, first-time entrepreneur, or business owner in an underserved community? Benefit from expanded mentoring and streamlined access to capital.

heading: Real Help, Right Where You Are
text: Employee? Expanded ownership incentives create more opportunities to build wealth.

heading: Why This Matters
text: The BUILD Business Act shifts federal policy from simply recruiting employers to creating more of them. When small businesses succeed, communities create jobs, families build wealth, neighborhoods become stronger, and America's economy grows from the ground up.

text: Require business plans for grant applicants.

heading: 04 / Protecting Taxpayer Dollars
text: Maintain prudent underwriting standards for loans.

heading: 04 / Protecting Taxpayer Dollars
text: Publish annual audits and performance reports.

heading: 04 / Protecting Taxpayer Dollars
